releaseNotes: AI Study reliability fix: every passage you select now triggers a fresh AI request, and AI keeps working across many passages in one session. If AI can't answer, the app tells you exactly why (offline, rate-limited, timeout, invalid key, or a server error) instead of silently switching to an offline note — and every note is labeled so you always know whether it came from AI or the offline library. Reaching the daily AI limit now shows clear options: continue offline or add your own Gemini API key, with live key verification and an instant retry.
